text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping with Verxina
for training supplies—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah... Please look.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, you say?
How nostalgic...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I was just reminiscing a little.
About how I used to take on these challenges with my younger sisters.

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm not going home till I get first prize!
I want the sparkliest ooooone!!

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
......A miss again...
Why am I the only one who always loses... *sob*, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, you can spin Big Sis's turn too.
Cheval... come on, over here.
Let's ask Mama for some meat buns, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
did you get a raffle ticket
when we went shopping earlier?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Then please, allow me to try.
It's been a while, and I feel like giving it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Our aim is, of course—the top.
The grand prize, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina pumped herself up
and gave the raffle crank a spin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, a hot spring, huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Was our family trip the last time, I wonder?
I'm getting so excited.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs here are seriously amazing~!
When I took my ma here, she was absolutely thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
You should go with someone special too, little lady.
Ah, with your Trainer would be totally fine, of course!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that is true...
If it is someone 'precious' to youâ

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: She has other people who are important to her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Verxina is going on a trip,
it would be best for her to go with her family.
She'll be able to unwind better that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back. As I tried to hand the hot spring tickets
I was still holding to Verxina, who had grown quiet for some reason—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, please hold on to it
just like that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You can make it, can't you?
Because... you too...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You seem to know
my schedule quite well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right now is still a time where I must work hard...
Could you perhaps hand it to me
once things have settled down?
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: All it takes is for the future me to muster up some courage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without fully understanding why,
I ended up holding onto the hot springs ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: First prize...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
First place—I took number one, 1st place!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Verxina is happier about the award itself
rather than the actual prize.
However, the Salisbury steak looks rather sad.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right...!
Of course, I would be delighted to partake.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: What we must do in a time like this... is clear.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, when Verxina's family gathered,
I was invited to a lavish dinner
featuring a prime Salisbury steak as the main dish.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Verxina...
She was that happy about it?
choice_data_list: Yes, enough to make me forget about the prize.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Keep talking like that, and I'll stuff a hamburger patty in your mouth, you hear?
choice_data_list: I thought it was adorable, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aah, there it is!
Totally head over heels~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
?
What's that...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine!
Here, eat it while it's still warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the hamburg steak at the center,
the lively feast continued—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
S-Second prize...?
Even here...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it all started that day...!
Ever since that moment...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was a kid... at the club I belonged to,
those days when I was undefeated...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—My very first...
humiliating second place...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Back then, when I felt almost invincible,
a memory of defeat was etched deeply, so deeply into me—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then!
Every single time... and only when it matters most!
The number "2"... won't stop haunting me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Verxina was devastated.
However, this 2nd place prize is not to blame. The shopping district folks
also seem somewhat disheartened... Right now, I should—
choice_data_list: Look, though, there are tons of carrots!
Look, though, there are tons of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: It's not 2, it's a bunch! ...A ton of food!
It's not 2, it's a bunch! ...A ton of food!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Yes... that's right.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we hand these out to everyone...
like my little sisters, Tarumae-san,
and Golshi-san?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Verxina and I happily headed home with a massive haul of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... What a pity.
choice_data_list: It doesn't really look like it, though...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It felt a bit better emotionally
than drawing second prize, at least.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “However, what should we do? With just one—”

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What a pretty orange color.
Looks so delicious~...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Want a bite?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
!
Big Sis, are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'm sure the carrots are
eager for you to eat them up, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's hard, so be careful when you nibble on it.
Eat lots and grow big and strong, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina handed the carrot to the child with practiced ease.
Her heart seemed filled with gentle warmth.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A losing ticket...?
Not even second prize...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Please allow me
to challenge it once more!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure!
I will show you my victory...!
choice_data_list: This isn't a race, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently something had struck a nerve,
as Verxina got far more heated
than I had ever imagined...
